# The Ice Hut

> Family-owned ice cream shop in Morinville, Alberta, Canada, serving premium Foothills Creamery ice cream since 1995. Known for 75+ rotating flavours, famously generous scoops, milkshakes, sundaes, gluten-free options, and $2.25 Puppy Cones for dogs.

## Key facts

- Address: 9911 100 Street, Morinville, Alberta, T8R 1R4, Canada (about 20 minutes north of Edmonton)
- Phone: (780) 974-9944
- Email: dawn@morinvilleicehut.ca
- Season: open May through September; closed October–April
- Hours May–June: Monday–Friday 3:00pm–9:30pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:30pm
- Hours July–August: every day 12:00pm–9:30pm
- Hours September: Monday–Friday 3:00pm–9:00pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:00pm
- Founded: 1995, family-owned and operated
- Ice cream: premium Foothills Creamery (made in Alberta), 75+ rotating flavours
- Popular flavours: Chocolate Peanut Butter, New York Cherry Cheesecake, Sea Salt Caramel Fudge, Tiger, All Canadian Moose, Haskap Prairie Berry
- Dietary: no-nuts / no-gluten / no-eggs / no-lactose / no-dairy flags on the flavour board; gluten-free cones $1.50
- Dog-friendly: Puppy Cone available for $2.25
- Sizes: Kids Single $4.50, Kids Double $5.50, Single $6.50, Double $7.50, Giant (3 flavours) $9.00; waffle cone +$1.50
- Other eats: Ice Cream Nachos $9.75, Ice Cream Float $8.50, Milkshakes $9.00 (24 oz) / $11.00 (32 oz); prices before GST
- Tagline: Cold Treats & Other Eats
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/morinvilleicehut/
